title: Build a two-dimensional density map
description: You evaluate a kernel density estimate on a grid around standardized observations.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You compute squared distances from every evaluation point to every observation. Gaussian contributions are summed and normalized to produce one density value per point.
You choose bandwidth h2 from the sample count and d=2. The mesh uses the supplied positions per axis and extends three units beyond the observed range on each side.

steps.question: Why does the density result need reshape(xx.shape)?
steps.answer: pts holds the grid as a flat list of coordinate pairs. Reshaping restores the two-dimensional layout used by the contour plot.

steps.description: You display the density as filled contours and overlay the observations. The title labels the estimate isotropic, meaning it uses the same bandwidth in both directions.
